Jeffrey Epstein may be dead, but his network is not. 

The line between justice and a cover-up is simple: release every file, name every name, and hold every person accountable, no matter who it implicates. 

Survivors have waited long enough.

LOWCOUNTRY UPDATE
Weekly Report from Congresswoman Nancy Mace

CONSTITUENT SERVICES
Our casework team is managing 600 active cases and has now returned $38,321,900 directly to constituents owed money by the federal government, a $24,000 increase from last week alone.

IN THE DISTRICT
Our team completed 19 events, meetings, ribbon cuttings, and site visits across the Lowcountry this week, including:
➡️Lowcountry Retired Law Enforcement Officers Association
➡️Press Conference in Bluffton
➡️Sleep i

We held a press conference back home in our district after returning from our second back-to-back trip to the Middle East.

The experiences we had, the things we saw, and the people we met will stay with us forever.

Our priority remains clear: getting every American out of the region and keeping U.S. troops off the ground.

If a single boot of a single American soldier sets foot on Iranian soil, I will vote against this. 

I will not vote to fund sending South Carolina’s sons and daughters to die in a ground war in Iran.


The Associated Press (@AP)

BREAKING: The Pentagon seeks $200 billion in additional funds for the Iran war, AP source says. apnews.com/article/iran-war-…




— https://nitter.net/AP/status/2034620725596733805#m

We applaud @Delta. 

If the Senate can't get it together and fund TSA, let them feel what every other American is feeling. Stand with the people you're supposed to serve.
Unless you are in our country illegally, you have absolutely no reason to worry about ICE officers in our airports.

Under the Biden Administration's open border policies, over 300,000 children entered our country and disappeared. Unaccounted for. Untracked. Lost.

We introduced the No More Missing Children Act to instill strict vetting of sponsors, GPS tracking of children, mandatory home inspections, and immediate custody removal when a child is unsafe.

Every child deserves protection. Keeping the most vulnerable safe from trafficking and abuse isn't political.

We’re still waiting on the SAVE America Act to be passed.

Election integrity is the foundation of American democracy. Without secure elections, we have no democracy at all.

If you are an American citizen, you can easily obtain an ID to vote. If you are not an American citizen, you should not be voting.

It’s common sense. Voter ID doesn’t prevent voting. It prevents fraud.

The government has locked people up for decades with far less evidence than what exists in the Epstein case. 

Ask yourself why.
Bombing Iran with one hand and buying Iran oil with the other.

The Save America Act is about protecting the future of our country.

If election fraud continues and illegal immigrants are allowed to vote, real Americans are being silenced. Every fraudulent ballot cancels out a citizen. Every illegal vote takes away a citizen’s voice. This is not complicated. This is not a conspiracy. This is happening right now.

It needs to stop. Pass the Save America Act.

Lindsey Graham needs to be removed from the Situation Room. 

I don't want to hear one word from a guy with no kids, desperately sending our sons and daughters into war on the ground in Iran.

Lindsey Graham has one foreign policy: send someone else's kids to war.

He was wrong about Iraq.
He was wrong about Afghanistan.
Now he's wrong about Iran.

Iwo Jima cost 6,821 American lives.


NewsWire (@NewsWire_US)

Lindsey Graham on Iran's Kharg Island: "We did Iwo Jima. We can do this."







— https://nitter.net/NewsWire_US/status/2035754177436041531#m
Are you willing for your kid to die to lower the price of oil?

Lindsey Graham wants American troops on the ground in Iran. Not his kids. Yours. Not for freedom. But for the price of oil. 

Unless he's suiting up for Kharg Island himself, he should sit down.
Lindsey Graham should stop fantasizing about war and pass the SAVE America Act in the Senate.
Senator Graham, why don't you deploy to Iran yourself if you're so eager to send everyone else over there?

American lives are not collateral damage for the price of oil. 

Boots on the ground is the LAST resort. Not a first response. Not a talking point. 

Lindsey Graham's race to war and sacrificing South Carolina’s sons and daughters over oil has shown us everything we need to know.
